metadata.title: Lived Experiences Action Plan
metadata.preparedFor: Advancing Together, Black Hawk County Public Health, and lived experience partner organizations
metadata.shortPurpose: Expand lived experience leadership, strengthen feedback loops, and reduce barriers to community participation in decision-making.
metadata.purpose: This charter-style action plan guides quarterly work for Advancing Together, Black Hawk County Public Health, and partner organizations to expand an existing lived experience leadership structure and reduce financial and structural barriers for community members contributing to shared decision-making. The plan emphasizes the Community Advisory Council, partner recruitment, feedback loops, and organizational compensation practices.
metadata.coalitionRole: Advancing Together supports CAC expansion, partner coordination, recommendation tracking, and compensation practices that make participation more accessible.

editorNotes: After reviewing external form submissions, update the relevant action row status, publicUpdateNote, and lastUpdated fields.
Use the existing Q1-Q10 quarter IDs so the static Gantt chart continues to render correctly.
To add future plans, use this same structure in a new JSON file and point a static action-plan page at it.

sections.title: Governance and CAC Expansion
sections.summary: Confirm roles, charter expectations, and the expanded CAC meeting structure.

actions.title: Confirm the expanded Community Advisory Council scope and charter review process.
keyTasks: Review draft CAC charter with current CAC members
confirm purpose, member expectations, confidentiality, participation supports, and how recommendations move to Advancing Together and partner organizations
resources: translation and interpretation budget if needed
successIndicators: Draft charter is reviewed with CAC members and at least three revisions or confirmations from members are documented
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Convene lead and core partner planning meeting to assign year-one roles.
keyTasks: Confirm who will help plan, recruit, host, interpret, document, and report back
identify partners whose role is advisory, support, or implementation
note United Way follow-up once staffing is in place
resources: shared file space or email distribution list
successIndicators: Role matrix is completed with at least six partner organizations assigned to a concrete year-one role
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Set the FY27 CAC calendar and topic plan for five total meetings by June 30, 2027.
keyTasks: Align two CAH-supported meetings and three BHCPH-supported meetings
select topics tied to economic stability barriers
reserve locations
identify interpretation, translation, food, transportation, and follow-up needs
successIndicators: Calendar, topics, and support needs are confirmed for five meetings through June 2027
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Host a second CAC session using the expanded meeting structure.
responsibleParties: CAH grant staff or topic partners
keyTasks: Use lessons from the first expanded session
invite partner presenters only when aligned with member priorities
test non-email reminders and additional participation supports identified in the scan
successIndicators: Attendance, participation supports used, recommendations, and member feedback are documented and compared with the prior session
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

sections.title: Representation and Participation Supports
sections.summary: Recruit people not currently reached and test practical access supports.

actions.title: Complete a representation, access, and participation-barrier scan for CAC membership.
keyTasks: Compare CAC applications and attendance with available data on areas with higher burden
document barriers such as transportation, language access, childcare, meeting times, trust, technology, payment processes, and clarity of purpose
successIndicators: Scan identifies priority outreach gaps and at least five practical participation supports to test in year one
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Launch partner-supported recruitment for people not currently reached by the CAC.
keyTasks: Use trusted messengers, language options, QR and paper sign-up options, and relationship-based outreach to invite community members with experience of economic barriers, homelessness or housing instability, behavioral health needs, immigrant/refugee experiences, or older adult needs
successIndicators: At least four partner organizations complete recruitment activities and new applicants or participants reflect at least three identified outreach gaps
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Host the first expanded FY27 CAC session on economic stability barriers and recommendations.
responsibleParties: core partners serving as topic resources
keyTasks: Provide interpretation and translated materials
compensate participants
use facilitation that documents barriers, recommendations, and who has authority to respond
include a clear next-step explanation before adjournment
successIndicators: Session is held with documented recommendations, attendance, languages supported, payments processed, and next steps shared with participants
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Host a third CAC session with shared agenda-setting or co-facilitation tested.
keyTasks: Ask CAC members to choose or refine part of the agenda
test a community member role such as welcome, discussion lead, or co-facilitator
document what support was needed for that role
resources: compensation for added role if allowable
successIndicators: At least one shared agenda-setting or co-facilitation practice is tested and member feedback is captured
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

sections.title: Feedback, Tracking, and Use of Recommendations
sections.summary: Track recommendations, report back to participants, and connect input to coalition action.

actions.title: Build a recommendation tracking and feedback-loop template.
responsibleParties: partner organizations with authority to act on recommendations
keyTasks: Create categories for acted on, referred, pending, and not feasible
identify the receiving organization or coalition
define how updates will be returned to CAC members and shared with Advancing Together
successIndicators: Template is used for all recommendations from expanded CAC sessions, and each recommendation has an owner or referral path
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Produce a year-one CAC summary and action/referral report.
keyTasks: Summarize meetings held, participation supports, outreach gaps, recommendations, actions taken, referrals, pending items, and lessons for FY28
return the summary to CAC members in accessible formats
successIndicators: Report is shared with CAC members, Advancing Together, and partner organizations, with status assigned to each recommendation
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Hold topic-based CAC or lived experience sessions tied to partner action areas.
responsibleParties: partner organizations with authority over selected topics
keyTasks: Select topics from CAC priorities and partner needs
clarify before each meeting what can change, what can be referred, and what is outside the group authority
update the recommendation tracker after each session
successIndicators: At least three topic-based sessions are held or scheduled, and 100% of recommendations receive an action, referral, pending, or not feasible status
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q6: Oct-Dec 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Integrate CAC recommendations into Advancing Together quarterly convenings and progress tracking.
keyTasks: Add a standing lived experience input update to quarterly convenings
connect recommendations to strategy workgroups
identify indicators that can be tracked in the data hub or coalition reports
successIndicators: CAC or lived experience input is reviewed at least quarterly and appears in coalition progress reporting
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028 - Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.

actions.title: Complete a final 2026-2028 summary and 2029 sustainability workplan.
keyTasks: Summarize action-plan completion, meetings held, participation supports, recommendations acted on or referred, compensation policy progress, remaining gaps, and next-year decisions
return results to CAC members and partners
successIndicators: Final summary and 2029 workplan are completed, shared with CAC members and Advancing Together, and used to set next-cycle priorities
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.

sections.title: Compensation Policy and Resource Sustainability
sections.summary: Operationalize compensation, support partner policy adaptation, and plan for resources.

actions.title: Finalize BHCPH internal procedures for compensating community members.
responsibleParties: Black Hawk County fiscal staff as needed
keyTasks: Document payment workflow, required forms, timing, allowable roles, and options for reducing structural barriers to payment
clarify whether participant, advisor, co-facilitator, and planning roles can be compensated differently
successIndicators: SOP is approved for CAC use and payment steps are ready before the first expanded FY27 meeting
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Share BHCPH community compensation policy examples and collect partner policy questions.
keyTasks: Present BHCPH policy and SOP lessons
collect barriers partners face with payments, procurement, gift cards, stipends, mileage, childcare, or role-based compensation
identify which questions require policy or fiscal review
successIndicators: At least five organizations receive the policy example and at least three policy or process barriers are documented for follow-up
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Develop a FY28/FY29 resource and funding plan for CAC continuation and participation supports.
responsibleParties: Cedar Valley United Way when staffing allows
keyTasks: Estimate costs for meetings, compensation, interpretation, translation, transportation, food, childcare, co-facilitator roles, and staff time
identify which needs can be met through existing grants, in-kind partner support, or new funding
successIndicators: Draft resource plan identifies committed resources, unfunded needs, and any policy or funding decisions needed for FY28/FY29
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Develop a community compensation toolkit or policy brief for partner organizations.
keyTasks: Package BHCPH examples, payment workflow lessons, role definitions, budget considerations, and participation-support options
include decision points for organizations adapting their own policies
successIndicators: Toolkit or brief is completed and shared through Advancing Together with a clear invitation for partner follow-up
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Provide partner technical assistance for compensation policy adoption or adaptation.
keyTasks: Offer office hours or small-group consultation
help partners identify decision-makers, payment barriers, budget needs, and policy language
document which organizations adopt, adapt, or defer changes
successIndicators: At least three organizations take a documented step toward adopting, adapting, or formalizing compensation practices
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q6: Oct-Dec 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Confirm sustainability agreements for CAC meetings and community leadership supports through December 2028.
responsibleParties: funders or host organizations as available
keyTasks: Confirm meeting frequency, staffing, hosting, compensation, interpretation, translation, transportation, and community advisor roles for the remainder of 2028
flag unresolved funding or policy decisions
successIndicators: Written sustainability commitments cover core meeting operations through December 2028, or unresolved needs are escalated with a decision timeline
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Evaluate progress on shared leadership and compensation practices.
keyTasks: Review member feedback, attendance patterns, payment timeliness, partner policy progress, advisor/co-facilitator roles, and use of CAC recommendations
update charter, SOP, or toolkit as needed
successIndicators: Evaluation summary identifies progress, remaining barriers, and specific changes to sustain or improve the model
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q9: Jul-Sep 2028.

sections.title: Coordination with Lived Experience Groups and Shared Leadership
sections.summary: Coordinate with existing groups and test shared leadership roles without duplication.

actions.title: Scan CAC-like and lived experience groups to avoid duplication and identify coordination options.
responsibleParties: NAMI or homeless coordinating board contacts
keyTasks: Map groups, focus areas, meeting rhythm, participant supports, and leadership structure
ask where coordination would help and where groups prefer to remain separate
identify community-led models worth learning from
successIndicators: Inventory documents at least five groups or engagement structures and names at least two coordination opportunities or guardrails against duplication
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Adjust CAC membership and operations based on year-one findings.
keyTasks: Use the year-one report and representation scan to update recruitment priorities, meeting supports, reminder methods, agenda design, and member expectations
confirm what changes are feasible within available resources
successIndicators: Updated operating approach is documented and at least two participation barriers are addressed through changed practice
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Pilot community advisor or co-facilitator roles in CAC planning.
keyTasks: Define role options
invite interested members
provide preparation support
compensate added responsibilities where allowable
document what decisions community advisors can influence
successIndicators: At least two community members participate in a planning, advisor, or co-facilitation role and report that expectations were clear
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Coordinate with CAC-like groups on participation supports and referral pathways.
keyTasks: Use the group scan to identify where shared interpretation, translation, transportation, outreach, or reporting practices could help
avoid asking the same participants for repeated input without feedback
successIndicators: At least two coordination practices are agreed to, such as shared referral language, meeting calendars, support resources, or feedback-loop expectations
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Lived Experiences source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.
